title: Conservative screening of temporal aggregation bias in battery–electrolyzer energy allocation: code, provenance and derived results
description: Version 3 adds a tightened native finite-capacity bracket (502.790566–502.811466 MWh), matched one-, five- and fifteen-minute decision comparisons, independently replayed schedules and dual certificates, full local screening timings, all-quarter diagnostic summaries, corrected GB transfer feasibility, and portable reconstruction plus synthetic demonstration code. Source provider records and native caches are not included. Original code is MIT licensed; derived figures and result documentation retain CC BY 4.0. See revision/README.md.
